performance_governance.rule: Future infrastructure-only commits may update readiness and admission evidence after this preregistration. They may not alter src/**, reference/**, P2E24 case controls, benchmark source, timing schedule, sample count, statistics or claim rules.

primary_comparison.comparator: casewise Reference N_hi under P2E21 representation-bounded research policy
primary_comparison.scientific_meaning: Reference N_hi is the least-refined tested Richards configuration with equal-or-better realized error to REF-HIGH.
primary_comparison.left_censored_interpretation: Reference N=1 is more accurate than RossFast N=1, so the comparison is conservative for RossFast but is not strict equality.

secondary_bracket_comparison.meaning: N_lo is the last tested coarser valid Reference configuration with slightly worse realized error than RossFast.

benchmark_execution.build: GNU Fortran, -O2, same locked scientific source graph, no -fcheck timing instrumentation
benchmark_execution.child_cpu_affinity: single selected CPU from admitted MP host evidence
benchmark_execution.primary_pair_order: alternate ROSS,REF_HI and REF_HI,ROSS by cycle; reverse case traversal on alternating cycles
benchmark_execution.secondary_pair_order: alternate ROSS,REF_LO and REF_LO,ROSS by cycle on the 34 bracketed cases
benchmark_execution.process_output: deterministic variant-specific scientific fingerprint; every measured repetition must match its warmup-established fingerprint
benchmark_execution.qualification_window_throttling: must remain zero over the entire timing workflow

metrics_and_resolution.wall_metric_role: secondary corroboration; it cannot rescue a failed child-CPU resolution gate

population_reporting.case_level_primary: median REF_HI/ROSS child-CPU ratio, mean paired relative delta, paired stdev and MDE
population_reporting.left_censored: report cases 7 and 8 separately as conservative Reference-more-accurate comparisons
population_reporting.bracket_sensitivity: for 34 cases report whether Ross is resolved faster than both N_lo and N_hi, lies within the measured cost bracket, or is slower than N_hi

claim_rules.no_production_reference_policy_claim: The timed Reference comparator uses the P2E21 representation-bounded research policy, not the fixed production Reference tolerance policy.

hard_execution_gates: host admission summary is admitted at 1% target
source and reference trees unchanged from P2E23
P2E24 benchmark source and schedule blobs match preregistered authority
all warmup and measured outputs are deterministic per case/variant
no cgroup throttling during full timing window
exactly 44 primary measured pairs for each of 36 cases
exactly 44 secondary measured pairs for each of 34 bracketed cases

current_blocker.evidence: benchmarks/performance/isolated-runner-readiness.json currently has status INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING and the checked-in MP host-admission summary is not admitted.
current_blocker.interpretation: This blocks execution only. It does not invalidate P2E23 matched-error controls or the frozen P2E24 timing design.

next_permitted_action: Implement the P2E24 benchmark executable, timing collector and manual self-hosted workflow without executing timing. Execution becomes permitted only after a separate infrastructure-only change records HOST_ADMITTED readiness and an admitted MP host baseline.
